help.progressCounted: Total — published topics in all subjects where you opened a lesson or took a quiz. Mastered — topics with 80 % or more. Percent = mastered ÷ total × 100, one decimal. Values are at the end of the period; the change is against the end of the comparison period.

help.streakCounted: A study day is a day when you opened a lesson or finished a quiz (Astana time, UTC+5). The streak is the run of study days ending today or yesterday; otherwise 0.
